# South Bend Cash Home Buyers

> Local cash home buyer serving South Bend, Mishawaka, Granger,
> Elkhart, and the greater Michiana area (St. Joseph County, IN;
> Elkhart County, IN; Berrien County, MI). We buy single-family
> homes, condos, townhomes, and small multifamily for cash, close
> in 7-30 days, and pay all closing costs. No agent commissions,
> no repair credits, no contingencies. Locally operated, funded
> with our own capital.

## Service area

Michiana — St. Joseph, Elkhart, and Berrien counties. Primary cities:

- South Bend, IN (46601-46637)
- Mishawaka, IN (46544-46546)
- Granger, IN (46530, 46545)
- Elkhart, IN (46514-46517)
- Niles, MI (49120)
- Osceola, IN (46561)
- Roseland, IN

Other communities: New Carlisle, North Liberty, Lakeville, Walkerton,
Goshen, Bristol, Middlebury, Nappanee, Buchanan MI, Cassopolis MI,
Edwardsburg MI.

## Offer terms

- Free, no-obligation written cash offer within 24 hours
- Close in as fast as 7 days, typical close 14-30 days
- Properties bought as-is — no repair credits, no inspection
  re-negotiations
- South Bend Cash Home Buyers pays all closing costs
- We use our own capital — no financing or appraisal contingencies
- Closing at a St. Joseph County, Elkhart County, or Berrien
  County (MI) title company

## Seller situations we work with

- Pre-foreclosure (Indiana is a judicial foreclosure state under
  Indiana Code Title 32 Article 29; St. Joseph Superior Court
  handles cases; typical 150-180 day timeline; we close before
  sheriff's sale)
- Inherited / probate houses (Indiana Code Title 29; St. Joseph
  Probate Court; supervised vs unsupervised probate; Small Estate
  Affidavit available under $100,000)
- Divorce sales (Indiana is equitable distribution; 60-day waiting
  period; both parties cash out same date)
- Distressed / as-is properties (fire, frozen-pipe damage from harsh
  Michiana winters, foundation issues from northern Indiana clay
  soils, code violations, hoarding, long-vacant homes)
- Notre Dame faculty/staff relocations
- Beacon Health (Saint Joseph) medical-professional moves
- RV-industry layoff cycles in Elkhart (Forest River, Coachmen, Thor)
- AM General, Bosch, Honeywell employee transfers
- Out-of-state inheritances (entire transaction handled remotely)
- Tired landlords and investor exits

## When a cash sale is not the right choice

If the property is in good condition, the seller has time for a
60-90 day MLS listing, and there are no urgency factors (sheriff's
sale, relocation, condition issues) — a traditional listing will
typically net more after costs. We'll say so on the first call.

## What we are not

We are not realtors. We do not list properties on the MLS. We are
a professional home-buying operation purchasing with our own funds.
